questions.stem: An organization is moving its email server off-premises to a cloud provider. Which of the following is an accurate statement about this migration?

choices.text: Cloud email reduces redundancy compared to on-premises
Cloud email provides scalable storage, built-in redundancy, and anywhere access
Cloud email requires a dedicated VPN for all users to connect
Cloud email security is the sole responsibility of the customer

questions.explanation: Cloud services provide scalability (add capacity on demand), redundancy, backup, and access from any internet-connected location. Physical and logical security is handled by the provider.
questions.trap: (a) reverses the benefit - cloud has MORE redundancy. (c) VPN is not required for standard cloud email. (d) Security is a shared responsibility with the provider.

questions.stem: A user saves a file to their local OneDrive folder on their laptop. What happens next?

choices.text: The file is available only on that laptop until manually uploaded
The file is automatically synced to the cloud and appears on all other devices with OneDrive
The file is backed up to the corporate file server
The file is encrypted and only accessible with a recovery key

questions.explanation: Cloud sync clients monitor the local folder and automatically upload changes to the cloud, which then replicates to all other devices running the same client.
questions.trap: (a) Cloud sync is automatic - no manual upload required. The whole point is automatic replication.

questions.stem: An IT administrator adds a new employee to Microsoft Entra ID. The company also uses Okta. What action does the admin need to take in Okta?

choices.text: Manually add the user to Okta separately
Nothing - the change propagates automatically via identity synchronization
Export the Entra ID user file and import it into Okta
Disable the user in Entra ID first, then add them in Okta

questions.explanation: Cloud identity synchronization automatically propagates user changes across all connected identity providers. Adding the user in one place updates all others.
questions.trap: (a) That defeats the purpose of identity sync. Modern cloud identity platforms push changes automatically.

questions.stem: An IT manager notices that 30 software licenses are assigned to employees who left the company 6 months ago. What should they do with cloud-based license management?

choices.text: Purchase 30 new licenses for the replacement employees
Reassign the unused licenses from the former employees to the new employees
Contact the software vendor to transfer ownership of the licenses
Leave the licenses assigned to avoid a deactivation fee

questions.explanation: Cloud license management provides central visibility into all licenses and their assignment. Unused licenses from former employees can be reassigned to new employees without purchasing additional seats.
questions.trap: (a) Purchasing new licenses wastes money if unused ones are available. Cloud licensing's main advantage is easy reassignment.

questions.stem: Match each cloud productivity concept to its best description.

pairs.rightText: File sync between local storage and cloud
Multiple users editing one document simultaneously
Centralized assignment and reassignment of software seats
Propagates user changes across all connected identity providers

questions.explanation: Cloud productivity covers email, file storage, collaboration, identity, and licensing. Know what each service does and name examples.
